author: StewieFG
body:
Hello!

Today I have seen a little issue in the ban system; people that are getting banned for innapropriate usernames, should be able to ban evade on accounts that don't have innapropriate username, and they can be back with their main account after they change their name from rude to an ok name. 
Opinions?

title: Ban Evasion Issues

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body: I 100% agree. The staff team shouldn't be punishing for this.
replies.body_tagged: I 100% agree. The staff team shouldn't be punishing for this.

replies.author: Rainstruck
replies.body: Yes we have talked about this as a staff team. We will ban the inappropriate username for 30 days, or basically how long they can go until the have to change it again, but they are able to still go on other accounts and access Avicus. Yes it should be allowed and hopefully it will continue to be allowed.
